root_cause.text: The bq25980 driver requests the interrupt handler (via devm_request_threaded_irq) before registering the power supply (via devm_power_supply_register), causing the power supply to be freed before the IRQ is unregistered during removal, leading to a use-after-free when the handler calls power_supply_changed() on a dangling pointer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves `bq25980_power_supply_init` (which registers the power supply) before the `devm_request_threaded_irq` call, and the commit message explains that the reverse devm deallocation order causes the power supply to be freed while the IRQ handler is still active.
